def has_ham_cycle(n, edges):
    if n <= 2:
        return False
    adj = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for u,v in edges:
        adj[u][v]=adj[v][u]=True

def has_ham_path(n, edges):

        return False
    if n == 1:
        return True
    adj = [[False]*n for _ in range(n)]

        ok = all(adj[perm[i]][perm[i+1]] for i in range(n-1))
